sloka: उमा नन्दीश्वरश्चापि रम्भा वरुणकन्यका ।यथोक्तास्तपसा प्राप्तं न मिथ्या ऋषिभाषितम् ।। ६.६०.११ ।।।।
transliteration: umā nandīśvaraścāpi rambhā varuṇakanyakā ।yathoktāstapasā prāptaṁ na mithyā ṛṣibhāṣitam ।। 6.60.11 ।।।।

translations.english: "Uma, Nandeeswara, Rambha and daughter of Varuna have cursed me like that and the prediction of those endowed with vision has been attained by me."
